usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing SDN subnet's configuration — such as changing its gateway, DHCP ranges, DNS server, or SNAT setting — without recreating it. Requires 'SDN.Allocate' on the parent zone/vnet path; changes take effect after applying the pending SDN config via the reload endpoint. Use the 'digest' param to guard against concurrent modifications when running automation.

examples.summary: Update subnet to add a DHCP DNS server and enable SNAT masquerade

tips: Changes are staged — run the SDN apply/reload endpoint after updating to push config to all nodes.
The 'delete' param accepts a comma-separated list of field names (e.g. 'dnszoneprefix,dhcp-dns-server') to unset optional fields without a full rewrite.
The gateway is only meaningful for layer3 (routed) zones; it will be assigned as the vnet interface IP on the controlling node.
SNAT (masquerade) only applies when pve-firewall is active on the node; enabling it without the firewall has no effect.
